h: Brother and sister both graduate with first-class degrees from UNILORIN
p: A brother and sister have both reportedly earned first-class degrees from the University of Ilorin, in different departments and with different CGPAs. Their achievement is being celebrated online.
more: The University of Ilorin has had several widely shared first-class stories this week.
